captions.detailed: A light mountain artillery pack cannon featuring a short, tapered bronze-colored barrel mounted on a dark green split-trail carriage. The carriage has two long, dark green trail legs extending backwards, ending in flat spade feet, and is supported by two brown wooden-spoked wheels with black iron rims. The barrel pivots vertically on trunnion revolute joints, the wheels rotate on a central axle, and the trail legs fold outward on revolute hinges.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a mountain pack cannon using CadQuery. The assembly should feature a tapered bronze barrel, a dark green split-trail carriage with two folding trail legs, and two spoked wheels on a common axle, incorporating revolute joints for the barrel elevation, wheel rotation, and trail leg articulation.
captions.factory: Construct the main carriage base using box and cylinder primitives for the cheeks and axle. Model the spoked wheels by combining a central hub cylinder, radial spokes, and an outer rim, then attach them to the axle using revolute joints. Create the tapered barrel using a series of lofts or stepped cylinders with a central bore, adding cylindrical trunnions to mount it to the carriage cheek plates with a revolute elevation joint. Finally, model the two trail legs with spade ends using extruded profiles and attach them to the rear of the carriage via vertical revolute joints.
